instructions: This is a strict TypeScript Electron app built with pnpm, React, and Vite. Prioritize correctness, security, privacy, and cross-platform behavior over cosmetic style comments. Treat the Electron main process, preload bridge, and renderer as separate trust boundaries. Review changes against the existing test and build scripts in package.json.

rules.rule: Preserve Electron security boundaries. Keep nodeIntegration disabled, contextIsolation enabled, and the preload API narrow. Validate untrusted IPC inputs and do not expose Node.js capabilities directly to the renderer.

Never log, persist, send to the renderer, or include in diagnostics an OAuth token or raw auth.json content. Preserve the read-only credential handling contract and keep authentication data in the main process.

Review filesystem, network, IPC, and timer changes for explicit failure handling, bounded waits, and safe cleanup. Preserve best-effort behavior where a missing profile or session log should not crash the app.

Require or update deterministic tests when changing usage calculations, config normalization or persistence, credential parsing, provider response mapping, or session-log scanning. Do not add tests that depend on live Codex credentials or network access.
